Inherited components and source locations

The unmodified runtime binaries and libraries originate from FCL main
52eb2b3aa51e677bc0382431e8788cc65ff43fc3. Original notices, bundled JRE legal
files and upstream source headers are retained. Source/build projects:

OpenJDK (GPL-2.0 with Classpath Exception), Java 8/17/21/25:
https://github.com/FCL-Team/Android-OpenJDK-Build
Use the Build_JRE_8, Build_JRE_17, Build_JRE_21 and Build_JRE_25 branches.
JRE licenses are inside the runtime archives under LICENSE or legal/.
OpenAL Soft (LGPL-2.1): https://github.com/FCL-Team/OpenAL
https://github.com/kcat/openal-soft
Oboe (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/google/oboe
Terracotta (AGPL-3.0): https://github.com/burningtnt/Terracotta
EasyTier (LGPL-3.0): https://github.com/EasyTier/EasyTier
TouchController proxy-client-android 0.0.5 (LGPL-3.0):
https://github.com/TouchController/TouchController
LWJGL (BSD-3-Clause): https://github.com/FCL-Team/lwjgl3
The launcher-specific Java patches are in LWJGL/ in this release's source.
GL4ES (MIT): https://github.com/ptitSeb/gl4es
NG-GL4ES (MIT): https://github.com/ShirosakiMio/NG-GL4ES
ByteHook (MIT): https://github.com/bytedance/bhook
SDL (zlib): https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL
Discord RPC (MIT): https://github.com/discord/discord-rpc

Additional copied license texts in this directory supplement the existing
upstream README credits. AMD FSR1 and Michal Drobot notices, khash and Khronos
platform notices are reproduced from the pinned MobileGlues source tree.
The PFFFT/FFTPACK notice comes from OpenAL's common/pffft.cpp; its terms permit
redistribution. Per-file terms continue to apply to all components.
